Assistant A better fulfills the user's request. While both responses are professional and cover the three required topics (data analysis, presentation style, and clarity of conclusions), Assistant A adheres strictly to the instruction to "keep the email short and to the point." It delivers a concise, direct message that includes all necessary elements without unnecessary elaboration. Assistant B, though thorough and well-structured, is significantly longer, includes unrequested details (such as a specific deadline and extensive sub-questions), and therefore deviates from the brevity constraint.

[[A]]
